Disappointing. Extremely disappointing experience with Swiggy’s customer service.

I have been trying to get a refund of ₹374 for an order, and despite repeated follow-ups, the issue remains unresolved.

Swiggy claims that the refund has been initiated and has even provided an RRN number. However, when I contacted my bank (SBI), they clearly informed me that no such refund transaction was traceable in their system.

What’s even more disappointing is that my consumer complaint was closed simply because Swiggy provided an RRN number, despite the fact that I haven’t received my money.

Providing an RRN is not the same as ensuring that a refund has actually reached the customer’s bank account.

As a regular customer who also orders from other food delivery platforms, I expect transparency, accountability and proper customer support.

Customers should not have to repeatedly chase a company for their own money.

I hope Swiggy takes this matter seriously and resolves the issue instead of simply marking complaints as closed
